$comment: What `act type` reports about the text it finds in the field afterwards (`textLanded=`), given the field's text before, after, and what was typed. Read by BOTH the Kotlin (reticle-helper TypeReadbackTest) and Swift (ReticleProtocol TypeReadbackTests) suites. `loss` is whether the shape is characters going missing (worth re-sending), as opposed to the app or the input path transforming them. Lengths are counted in characters; keep cases to the Basic Multilingual Plane so UTF-16 and grapheme counts agree.
